features.description: Wins during each 10-spin cycle reduce a monster's health.

features.name: Three bonus games

features.name: Hero symbols
features.description: Four heroes with unique symbols and abilities.

review:
Adventures takes BGaming's Bonanza engine and turns it into a little anime RPG. Four heroes bring their own symbols, and every 10 spins you face a random monster – each winning combo knocks off some of its health. It sounds gimmicky, but it gives base-game wins an actual purpose.

Beat the monster before the cycle runs out and you get its bonus: the Goblin gives a coin respin, Cerberus spins a three-reel machine for a multiplier up to 999x, and the Dragon lets you pick. Medium-low volatility and a 2,100x cap, 96.1% RTP. A relaxed one to play for a while.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
